questions.question: In a certain code language, 'FLORENCE' is coded as '86' and 'GRATITUDE' is coded as '114'. How is 'FOREIGN' coded in the given language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Sum of the place value of all numbers) + Number of letter in that word = Code of the word.

'FLORENCE' is coded as '86'

⇒ (6 + 12 + 15 + 18 + 5 + 14 + 3 + 5) + 8

⇒ 78 + 8 = 86.

'GRATITUDE' is coded as '114'

⇒ (7 + 18 + 1 + 20 + 9 + 20 + 21 + 4 + 5) + 9

⇒ 105 + 9 = 114.

Similarly, for '**FOREIGN**'

⇒ (6 + 15 + 18 + 5 + 9 + 7 + 14) + 7

⇒ 74 + 7 = 81.

So, 'FOREIGN' will be coded as '81'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

7 and 4

I. 7 × 8 + 4 - 9 ÷ 3 = 30

II. 9 + 4 × 8 ÷ 2 - 7 = 33
questions.solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

**Given equations:**

**I. 7 × 8 + 4 - 9 ÷ 3 = 30**

After interchanging 7 and 4 in equation (I):

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 4 × 8 + 7 - __**9 ÷ 3**__

⇒ __**4 × 8**__ + 7 - 3

⇒ 32 + 7 - 3 = 36

Here, the equation (I) is not satisfied.

**II. 9 + 4 × 8 ÷ 2 - 7 = 33**

After interchanging 7 and 4 in equation (II):

⇒ 9 + 7 × __**8 ÷ 2**__ - 4

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 9 + __**7 × 4**__ - 4

⇒ __**9 + 28**__ - 4

⇒ 37 - 4 = 33

⇒ LHS = RHS

Here, the **equation (II)** is **satisfied.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only II****".**

questions.question: If 9 × 6 = 45, 7 × 4 = 33 and 6 × 4 = 20, then what is the value of 5 × 3?
questions.solution:
The logic here is as follows,

9² – 6² = 81 – 36 = 45

7² – 4² = 49 – 16 = 33

6² – 4² = 36 – 16 = 20

Similarly,

5² – 3² = 25 – 9 = 16

Thus, the value of 5 × 3 = 16.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some men are athletes.

No athlete is a singer.

All singers are dancers.

**Conclusions:**

I. No dancer is an athlete.

II. Some singers are men.

III. Some men are dancers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/080e63bdc45fb024c0651cc57d2b728963f7d24b92e4addb4f5bb118a8123865.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No dancer is an athlete. → False (As, No athlete is a singer and All singers are dancers → Some dancer are not athlete) 

II. Some singers are men. → False (As, Some men are athletes, No athlete is a singer and All singers are dancers → No singers are men)

III. Some men are dancers. → False (As, Some men are athletes, No athlete is a singer and All singers are dancers → Some men are not dancers)

Hence, **none of the conclusions follow**.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All aliens are people.

All people are mammals.

All mammals are animals.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some animals are mammals.

II. All people are aliens.

options.text: Neither conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The correct Venn diagram representation is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6993f0eb02bbb52bace0b3c18910d6c1b808e5c403727dbb0a06b53964cb306.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I) Some animals are mammals. → Follows (The relationship between animals and mammals is all mammals are animals.)

II) All people are aliens. → Does not follows (The relationship between people and aliens is all aliens are people.) 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '÷' are interchanged and '-' and '×' are interchanged?

14 ÷ 6 - 4 × 15 + 5 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c4d7df08ed0dc4a592f34a8cfb9ebb6fa29e589acc02809a812d197ddc23bde.png] 

**Given:**

​⇒ 14 ÷ 6 - 4 × 15 + 5 = ?

After interchanging '+' and '÷' and '-' and '×' →

​⇒ 14 + 6 × 4 - __**15 ÷ 5**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

​⇒ 14 + __**6 × 4**__ - 3

​⇒ 14 + 24 - 3

​⇒ 38 - 3 = **35**

**​⇒ '14 + 6 × 4 - 15 ÷ 5 = 35'**

Here, the value of the equation is** '35'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".

options.text: F L C E X A F
F N X C X C F
F L X N X D C
F L X C X D F

questions.solution:
Given → N L A _ X N _ B F _ N L _ F _ N L _ _ X
